script_text: Saturn squares your natal Sun this week, Taurus — brace for a reality check that reshapes everything. Early week, Mercury in Leo trines your ruling planet Venus in the 2nd House of income, opening financial clarity Monday and Tuesday, but Mercury square Mars on Wednesday creates friction in communication — avoid arguments with partners. Mid-week, the Sun enters your 10th House of career, igniting a professional spotlight demanding you step forward. Late week, Venus conjunct Jupiter in your 7th House of partnerships brings unexpected romantic alignment Thursday and Friday, while the weekend shifts toward home and emotional grounding under the Earth element you thrive in. Wednesday is your power day because the Sun moves into your 10th House, amplifying career momentum. Thursday is your worst day because Mercury square Mars triggers miscommunication in love. Trust your instincts and make one bold financial decision before Friday. Follow for daily updates.
